title: licania hookeri

It is a tropical tree native to Central and South America, and its bark, leaves, and roots are used in traditional medicine. The plant has been found to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Licania hookeri include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
